verses.translation: Hear ye this word of the Lord, even a lamentation, which I take up against you. The house of Israel is fallen; it shall no more rise.

translations.ron: Ascultaţi cuvântul acesta pe care eu îl rostesc asupra voastră, cântec de jale pentru voi, cei din casa lui Israel:
translations.grk: Ἀκούσατε τὸν λόγον Κυρίου τοῦτον, ὃν ἐγὼ λαμβάνω ἐφʼ ὑμᾶς, θρῆνον. Οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ

verses.translation: The virgin of Israel has fallen upon his land; there is none that shall raise her up.

translations.ron: Căzut-a ca să nu se mai scoale fecioara lui Israel, trântită stă la pământ şi nimeni nu o ridică!
translations.grk: ἔπεσεν, οὐκέτι μὴ προσθήσει τοῦ ἀναστῆναι. Παρθένος τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἔσφαλεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ ἀναστήσων αὐτήν.

verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord God; The city out of which there went forth a thousand, in it there shall be left a hundred, and in that out of which there went forth a hundred, there shall be left ten to the house of Israel.

translations.ron: Că aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu casei lui Israel: "Cetatea care scotea o mie de oameni în luptă va rămâne cu o sută, şi cea care scotea o sută va rămâne cu zece".
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος Κύριος, ἡ πόλις ἐξ ἧς ἐξεπορεύοντο χίλιοι, ὑπολειφθήσονται ἑκατόν· καὶ ἐξ ἧς ἐξεπορεύοντο ἑκατὸν, ὑπολειφθήσονται δέκα τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Lord to the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live.

translations.ron: Că aşa zice Domnul către casa lui Israel:
translations.grk: Διότι τάδε λέγει Κύριος πρὸς τὸν οἶκον Ἰσραὴλ, ἐκζητήσατέ με, καὶ ζήσεσθε.

verses.translation: But seek not Bæthel, and go not in to Galgala, and cross not over to the Well of the Oath: for Galgala shall surely go into captivity, and Bæthel shall be as that which is not.

translations.ron: "Căutaţi-Mă şi veţi fi vii! Nu umblaţi după Betel şi în Ghilgal să nu intraţi şi nu treceţi pe lângă Beer-Şeba, căci Ghilgalul va fi dus în robie şi Betelul va rămâne o nimica toată.
translations.grk: Καὶ μὴ ἐκζητεῖτε Βαιθὴλ, καὶ εἰς Γάλγαλα μὴ εἰσπορεύεσθε, καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου μὴ διαβαίνετε, ὅτι Γάλγαλα αἰχμαλωτευομένη αἰχμαλωτευθήσεται, καὶ Βαιθὴλ ἔσται ὡς οὐχ ὑπάρχουσα.

verses.translation: Seek ye the Lord, and ye shall live; lest the house of Joseph blaze as fire, and it devour him, and there shall be none to quench it for the house of Israel.

translations.ron: Ci căutaţi pe Domnul ca să fiţi vii, ca nu cumva să dea flăcărilor casa lui Iosif, să fie mistuită şi nimeni să nu o poată stinge din cei din Betel.
translations.grk: Ἐκζητήσατε τὸν Κύριον, καὶ ζήσατε, ὅπως μὴ ἀναλάμψῃ ὡς πῦρ ὁ οἶκος Ἰωσὴφ, καὶ καταφάγῃ αὐτὸν, καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ὁ σβέσων τῷ οἴκῳ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.translation: It is he that executes judgment in the height above, and he has established justice on the earth:

translations.ron: Aceştia prefac judecata în pelin şi prăbuşesc dreptatea la pământ.
translations.grk: Ὁ ποιῶν εἰς ὕψος κρίμα, καὶ δικαιοσύνην εἰς γῆν ἔθηκεν·

verses.translation: who makes all things, and changes them, and turns darkness into the morning, and darkens the day into night: who calls for the water of the sea, and pours it out on the face of the earth: the Lord is his name:

translations.ron: Căutaţi pe Cel care a făcut Orionul şi Pleiadele, pe Cel care preface dimineaţa în întuneric adânc şi întunecă ziua ca noaptea, pe Cel care cheamă apa mării şi o varsă peste fata pământului. Domnul este numele Lui!
translations.grk: ὁ ποιῶν πάντα καὶ μετασκευάζων, καὶ ἐκτρέπων εἰς τοπρωῒ σκιάν, καὶ ἡμέραν εἰς νύκτα συσκοτάζων, ὁ προσκαλούμενος τὸ ὕδωρ τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ ἐκχέων αὐτὸ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς· Κύριος ὄνομα αὐτῷ·

verses.translation: who dispenses ruin to strength, and brings distress upon the fortress.

translations.ron: El aduce ruina peste cel puternic şi prăpădul peste cetatea cea întărită.
translations.grk: ὁ διαιρῶν συντριμμὸν ἐπὶ ἰσχὺν, καὶ ταλαιπωρίαν ἐπὶ ὀχύρωμα ἐπάγων.

verses.translation: They hated him that reproved in the gates, and abhorred holy speech.

translations.ron: Ei urăsc pe apărătorul dreptului la poarta cetăţii şi de cel ce grăieşte cinstit le este scârbă.
translations.grk: Ἐμίσησαν ἐν πύλαις ἐλέγχοντα, καὶ λόγον ὅσιον ἐβδελύξαντο.

verses.translation: Therefore because they have smitten the poor with their fists, and ye have received of them choice gifts; ye have built polished houses, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted desirable vineyards, but ye shall not drink the wine of them.

translations.ron: Drept aceea, fiindcă voi călcaţi în picioare pe cel sărman şi luaţi de la el dar de grâu, cu toate că aţi zidit case de piatră, nu le veţi locui, şi deşi aţi sădit viţă de bun soi, nu veţi bea din vinul ei.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ἀνθʼ ὧν κατεκονδύλιζον πτωχοὺς, καὶ δῶρα ἐκλεκτὰ ἐδέξασθε παρʼ αὐτῶν, οἴκους ξεστοὺς ᾠκοδομήσατε, καὶ οὐ μὴ κατοικήσητε ἐν αὐτοῖς· ἀμπελῶνας ἐπιθυμητοὺς ἐφυτεύσατε, καὶ οὐ μὴ πίητε τὸν οἶνον αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: For I know your many transgressions, and your sins are great, trampling on the just, taking bribes, and turning aside the judgment of the poor in the gates.

translations.ron: Că Eu ştiu că mari sînt fărădelegile voastre şi grele păcatele voastre, ca unii care asupriţi pe cel drept şi luaţi mită şi stoarceţi pe cei săraci la porţile cetăţii.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἔγνων πολλὰς ἀσεβείας ὑμῶν, καὶ ἰσχυραὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι ὑμῶν, καταπατοῦντες δίκαιον, λαμβάνοντες ἀλλάγματα, καὶ πένητας ἐν πύλαις ἐκκλίνοντες.

verses.translation: Therefore the prudent shall be silent at that time; for it is a time of evils.

translations.ron: Dar în vremea aceea omul cel înţelept va tăcea, că este vreme rea.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο ὁ συνιὼν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ σιωπήσεται, ὅτι καιρὸς πονηρῶν ἐστιν.

verses.translation: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live: and so the Lord God Almighty shall be with you, as ye have said,

translations.ron: Căutaţi binele şi nu răul, ca să fiţi vii şi aşa Domnul Dumnezeu Savaot va fi cu voi precum ziceţi că este.
translations.grk: Ἐκζητήσατε τὸ καλὸν, καὶ μὴ πονηρὸν, ὅπως ζήσητε, καὶ ἔσται οὕτως μεθʼ ὑμῶν Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ὃν τρόπον εἴπατε,

verses.translation: We have hated evil, and loved good: and restore ye judgment in the gates; that the Lord God Almighty may have mercy on the remnant of Joseph.

translations.ron: Urâţi răul şi iubiţi binele şi hotărâţi judecata cea dreaptă la porţi, poate că Domnul Dumnezeu Savaot Se va milostivi de cei rămaşi ai lui Iosif.
translations.grk: μεμισήκαμεν τὰ πονηρὰ, καὶ ἠγαπήσαμεν τὰ καλά· καὶ ἀποκαταστήσατε ἐν πύλαις κρίμα, ὅπως ἐλεήσῃ Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ τοὺς περιλοίπους τοῦ Ἰωσήφ.

verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord God Almighty; In all the streets shall be lamentations; and in all the ways shall it be said, Woe, woe! the husbandman shall be called to mourning and lamentation, and to them that are skilled in complaining.

translations.ron: Pentru aceasta aşa grăieşte Domnul Dumnezeu Savaot, Atotţiitorul: "În toate pieţele plânset va fi şi pe toate uliţele se va auzi strigând: Vai! Vai! Plugarul va fi îndemnat la jale şi la tânguire lângă cei ce ştiu să se bocească.
translations.grk: Διατοῦτο τάδε λέγει Κύριος ὁ Θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πλατείαις κοπετὸς, καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς ῥηθήσεται οὐαὶ, οὐαί· κληθήσεται γεωργὸς εἰς πένθος καὶ κοπετὸν, καὶ εἰς εἰδότας θρῆνον.

verses.translation: And there shall be lamentation in all the ways; because I will pass through the midst of thee, saith the Lord.

translations.ron: Şi în toate viile va fi bocet, că Eu trec prin mijlocul tău", zice Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐν πάσαις ὁδοῖς κοπετὸς, διότι ἐλεύσομαι διὰ μέσου σου, εἶπε Κύριος.

verses.translation: Woe to you that desire the day of the Lord! what is this day of the Lord to you? whereas it is darkness, and not light.

translations.ron: Vai de cei ce doresc ziua Domnului! Ce se va întâmpla cu voi? Ziua Domnului este zi de întuneric si nu de lumină!
translations.grk: Οὐαὶ οἱ ἐπιθυμοῦντες τὴν ἡμέραν Κυρίου· ἱνατί αὕτη ὑμῖν ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου; καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶ σκότος καὶ οὐ φῶς.

verses.translation: As if a man should flee from the face of a lion, and a bear should meet him; and he should spring into his house, and lean his hands upon the wall, and a serpent should bite him.

translations.ron: Veţi fi ca un om care fuge din faţa leului şi dă peste un urs, şi ca unul care intră în casă şi se reazemă cu mâna de un perete şi îl muşcă şarpele.
translations.grk: Ὃν τρόπον ἐὰν φύγῃ ἄνθρωπος ἐκ προσώπου τοῦ λέοντος, καὶ ἐμπέσῃ αὐτῷ ἡ ἄρκος, καὶ εἰσπηδήσῃ εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀπερείσηται τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν τοῖχον, καὶ δάκῃ αὐτὸν ὄφις.

verses.translation: Is not the day of the Lord darkness, and not light? and is not this day gloom without brightness?

translations.ron: Nu va fi oare ziua Domnului întuneric şi nu lumină, beznă şi nu strălucire?
translations.grk: Οὐχὶ σκότος ἡ ἡμέρα τοῦ Κυρίου, καὶ οὐ φῶς, καὶ γνόφος οὐκ ἔχων φέγγος αὕτη;

verses.translation: I hate, I reject your feasts, and I will not smell your meat-offerings in your general assemblies.

translations.ron: Urât-am, dispreţuit-am prăznuirile voastre şi nu simt nici o plăcere pentru sărbătorile voastre.
translations.grk: Μεμίσηκα, ἀπῶσμαι ἑορτὰς ὑμῶν, καὶ οὐ μὴ ὀσφρανθῶ θυσίας ἐν ταῖς πανηγύρεσιν ὑμῶν.

verses.translation: Wherefore if ye should bring me your whole-burnt-sacrifices and meat-offerings, I will not accept them: neither will I have respect to your grand peace-offerings.

translations.ron: Când Îmi veţi aduce arderi de tot şi prinoase, nu le voi binevoi şi la jertfele de mântuire grase ale voastre nu voi pleca ochii.
translations.grk: Διότι ἐὰν ἐνέγκητέ μοι ὁλοκαυτώματα καὶ θυσίας ὑμῶν, οὐ προσδέξομαι, καὶ σωτηρίους ἐπιφανείας ὑμῶν οὐκ ἐπιβλέψομαι.

verses.translation: Remove from me the sound of thy songs, and I will not hear the music of thine instruments.

translations.ron: Depărtează de Mine zgomotul cântecelor tale, că nu am plăcere să ascult cântarea alăutelor tale!
translations.grk: Μετάστησον ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ἦχον ᾠδῶν σου, καὶ ψαλμὸν ὀργάνων σου οὐκ ἀκούσομαι.

verses.translation: But let judgment roll down as water, and righteousness as an impassable torrent.

translations.ron: Şi judecata se va năpusti ca apa ,Şi dreptatea ca un şuvoi furios.
translations.grk: Καὶ κυλισθήσεται ὡς ὕδωρ κρίμα, καὶ δικαιοσύνη ὡς χειμάῤῥους ἄβατος.

verses.translation: Have ye offered to me victims and sacrifices, O house of Israel, forty years in the wilderness?

translations.ron: Voi cei din casa lui Israel, Mi-aţi adus, oare, jertfe şi prinoase în pustiu, vreme de patruzeci de ani?
translations.grk: Μὴ σφάγια καὶ θυσίας προσηνέγκατέ μοι οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ;

verses.translation: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Ræphan, the images of them which ye made for yourselves.

translations.ron: Dar acum veţi aduce cu voi pe Sacut, regele vostru, şi steaua dumnezeului vostru, Chevan, idolii voştri pe care vi i-aţi făurit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνελάβετε τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ Μολὸχ, καὶ τὸ ἄστρον τοῦ θεοῦ ὑμῶν Ῥαιφὰν, τοὺς τύπους αὐτῶν οὓς ἐποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς.

verses.translation: And I will carry you away beyond Damascus, saith the Lord, the Almighty God is his name.

translations.ron: Şi Eu vă voi duce robi dincolo de Damasc, zice Domnul, al Cărui nume este Dumnezeu Savaot.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετοικιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐπέκεινα Δαμασκοῦ, λέγει Κύριος· ὁ Θεὸς ὁ παντοκράτωρ ὄνομα αὐτῷ.
